exposure: Delta variant of SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy
cohort: 96 pregnant women who tested positive for the Delta variant of SARS-CoV-2
finding: Pregnant women infected with the Delta variant of SARS-CoV-2, particularly those with severe disease, experienced higher rates of mortality, preterm delivery, and cesarean sections, with elevated CRP, WBC, and procalcitonin levels being correlated with poor prognosis.
mod_finding: Pregnant women infected with the Delta variant and with severe COVID-19 had an increased risk for preterm delivery and cesarean section.
